lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case abs L d _ => exact .inl (.abs (Typing.abs L d).wf.2.1)
  case tabs L d _ => exact .inl (.tabs (Typing.tabs L d).wf.2.1)
  case sub ih => exact ih rfl
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl with
    | inl vl =>
      cases ih_r rfl with
      | inl vr =>
        obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
        exact ⟨_, .abs vl.lc vr⟩
      | inr hr =>
        obtain ⟨_, hr⟩ := hr
        exact ⟨_, .appᵣ vl hr⟩
    | inr hl =>
      obtain ⟨_, hl⟩ := hl
      exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 hl⟩
  case tapp d s ih =>
    right
    have lc := (Sub.wf _ _ _ s).2.1.lc
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl v =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
      exact ⟨_, .tabs v.lc lc⟩
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
      exact ⟨_, .tapp lc h⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L d db ih _ =>
    right
    have body : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (db x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl v => exact ⟨_, .let_body v body⟩
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
      exact ⟨_, .let_bind h body⟩
  case inl d _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl v => exact .inl (.inl v)
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
      exact .inr ⟨_, .inl h⟩
  case inr d _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl v => exact .inl (.inr v)
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
      exact .inr ⟨_, .inr h⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ L d db₂ db₃ ih _ _ =>
    right
    have b₂ : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (db₂ x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    have b₃ : t₃.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (db₃ x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl v =>
      obtain ⟨_, h | h⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v
      · subst t₁
        cases v with | inl v => exact ⟨_, .case_inl v b₂ b₃⟩
      · subst t₁
        cases v with | inr v => exact ⟨_, .case_inr v b₂ b₃⟩
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h
      exact ⟨_, .case h b₂ b₃⟩

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            have ⟨σ, t₁, eq⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exists t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂
            grind
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', _⟩ := red_r
            exists t₁.app t₂'
            grind
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red_l
        exists t₁'.app t₂
        grind
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    specialize ih rfl der
    cases ih with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t, _⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exists t ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .tapp t' σ'
        grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl _ =>
        exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.let' t₂
        grind
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inl t'
        grind
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inr t'
        grind
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        have ⟨t₁, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        cases lr <;> [exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁; exists t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁] <;> grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.case t₂ t₃
        grind
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.abs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind
  case tabs L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.tabs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind
